dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 20, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Reds Rout Yankees, Twins Thrash Diamondbacks in MLB Action**

The Cincinnati Reds took down the New York Yankees 10-2 behind a big day from Sal Stewart, who drove in six runs on two hits. Will Warren earned the win for the Reds, striking out eight in 5.2 innings. Meanwhile, the Minnesota Twins exploded for 16 runs in a 16-8 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, led by Byron Buxton's four runs batted in. Taj Bradley earned the win for the Twins, allowing two earned runs in five innings.

In other action, the Los Angeles Angels shut out the Athletics 7-0 behind a strong outing from Walbert Ureña, who struck out six in five innings. Shohei Ohtani hit a home run to help the Baltimore Orioles edge the Los Angeles Dodgers 3-2. Trevor Rogers earned the win for the Orioles, allowing no earned runs in seven innings. The Boston Red Sox also picked up a win, defeating the Seattle Mariners 5-1 behind Connelly Early's six scoreless innings.

The Detroit Tigers took down the Chicago White Sox 4-1 behind a strong team effort, while the Washington Nationals edged the Tampa Bay Rays 4-3. The Cleveland Guardians cruised to an 8-1 win over the Houston Astros, led by Joey Cantillo's eight scoreless innings.
